title: Uhakandani Prema – Hosanna Ministries Telugu Christian Lyrics

intro: Uhakandani Prema is the latest Telugu Christian song from the album, Dayakshetram (Vol-35) released by Hosanna Ministries featuring Pastor, Singer, song-writer, Pastor John Wesley. This song video was released on March 06, 2025 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
